Why Onassis would walk into the right room first.

Kevin Trudeau shares what Aristotle Onassis said he would do if he lost everything. He would go where wealthy people gather, like a restaurant or a club, and simply be in the same room.

No pitching and no talking. Kevin explains the idea is that being near people with big, expanded dreams can change how you think.

Whose company has shaped your ambitions the most?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

Why two horses pull far more than double.

Kevin Trudeau uses a horse and cart to explain synergy. One horse can only pull so much, two pull more than twice as much, and three pull even more, because the effect builds on itself.

Kevin says the same goes for people. A few people who share goals and dreams can support one another, and their combined energy grows geometrically.

Who would you pull the cart with?
